title: Read optional-content layers and default visibility through pdfxi layers
acceptance: cargo test -p pdfxi-core --lib layers and cargo test -p pdfxi-cli pass; pdfxi layers reports OCG names, /OFF and /ON visibility, /BaseState and nested /Order depth on a real document; VIEW-010 moves to verified.
notes: Parses /OCProperties, /OCGs, the default configuration /OFF, /ON, /BaseState and nested /Order, and exposes a typed Layer list with visible and depth; the CLI prints text with indentation or stable JSON.
